answer: A newcomer earns a seat by grafting a branch onto an orchard tree, witnessed by two orchardists who log it as a vertex in the map. A graft that does not take within one epoch voids the claim and burns a 400 POA bond, barring re-entry 6 epochs. Each graft costs $150 for the scion plus a $70 fee, blossom pigment marking each graft, so 100 fake identities need 100 grafts, $22,000 in fees and 40,000 POA in bonds, while honest grafters bear fruit.
